== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Roche (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-roche-pre.gif]]) shows the original text (“may not target it”); the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-07-Roche.png]]) shows only the changed Light Side half.

* '''Text source:''' the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010: https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf; the slip [[:File:VB7-07-Roche.png]] gives the Light Side half) and the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013); Dark Side text unchanged from the Players Committee card image. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Light Side: Unless opponent controls this system, Commence Primary Ignition may not target Roche. Dark Side: Force drain -1 here. If you control, Asteroid Sanctuary at related sector is canceled.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1272_28</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
